beliefs: f(x) = g(x) + 'JTQL', where 'JTQL' is a fixed suffix appended to a transformed x [E1]
g applies a Caesar shift of -2 on lowercase letters (a->y, b->z, c->a, ..., z->x) [E1, E2]
g applies a Caesar shift of -2 on uppercase letters (A->Y, B->Z, C->A, ..., Z->X) [E1, E2]
Digits, symbols, and spaces are unchanged by g [E1]
Empty string maps to 'HTQL', so g('')='H' — an extra 'H' appears when input is empty [E1]
notes: E2 shows a uniform -2 Caesar shift on both cases (b->z, c->a, z->x, e->c, l->j, B->Z, C->A, Z->X), not just isolated substitutions; replaced the lookup table with modular shift.
